headword: {集客効果|しゅうきゃくこうか}

definitions.gloss: customer-drawing effect; ability to attract customers
definitions.explanation: The effect of drawing in customers or visitors; how well something pulls in a crowd. A marketing and retail term.

examples.japanese: ⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集客効果|しゅうきゃくこうか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: The sale's customer-drawing effect is large.

examples.japanese: ⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集客効果|しゅうきゃくこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測定|そくてい}→測定：04398_sokutei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: to measure an advertisement's ability to attract customers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{立地|りっち}→立地：13803_ricchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{集客効果|しゅうきゃくこうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: A location in front of a station is said to have a high customer-drawing effect.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{集客|しゅうきゃく}→集客：18040_shuukyaku⟧ ('attracting customers') + ⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ ('effect'). A marketing term for how effectively something pulls in customers or visitors.

- {集客効果|しゅうきゃくこうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ / ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: high / low customer-drawing power
- {集客効果|しゅうきゃくこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧: to aim for a customer-drawing effect
